title: Paddle Pros - A Real Life Physics Based Pickleball and Table Tennis Sports Game!
author: shaaake
selftext:
[https://www.youtube.com/shorts/E-O7KmaPPTM](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/E-O7KmaPPTM)

Hey everyone! This is Paddle Pros! Playable inside of the discord attached to this post!

A real life physics based paddle sports game soon coming to steam!

YOU have total control over every movement you make.

Can you hit a ball with top spin in real life? Replicate that motion in game, and you'll achieve the same result that you'd expect in real life.

Chop blocks, around the nets, anything will work, if you spend the time to learn it.

Even if you're the casual "play to 21 with your friends" type, you'll still find the same similar motions give you the desired results along with a party rules mode for that specific rule set.

The game itself is incredibly hard, but with each rally, you will see yourself improve slightly. You can download V70 from the discord above, and give it a shot either alone or with a friend!

If you've ever played any paddle sports in real life EVER, you will have some fun with friends in paddle pros. Join the discord and check it out!

Look, I respect developers. They have an incredibly hard job. Building a game that you don't know if people will enjoy, and becoming successful from it is an astronomically hard task. Unfortunately, any of the last 10 "Big" games that have come out, I have 0 interest in. I play incredibly niche games that have singular versions, with unique mechanics and there isn't "30 other games I can play"

I'm not here to step on toes, I just want to create unique games.

With that being said, I am a solo developer (though I prefer game director, due to my minimal coding) and I use AI to create games that will never exist. I will never hide the fact that I use AI. I don't steal, I don't copy. Every creative decision is put into my own words, and either found and paid for, or generated based off of my wording. I just want to create games that after 25 years of online gaming, that I find fun, along with my friends. If you don't want to support / play the game due to that fact, I completely understand, I just ask that you don't lump me into the "Slop" producing "looking for a buck" game developers. I am genuinely passionate about creating unique games, and have no means of doing so.

I've personally put 100+ hours ALREADY into this game, since I create it by playing it. If something isn't fun enough, I make it more fun.

If you don't really care about that stuff and just want to play awesome games, join the discord above. This is the first game out of the last 11 that I've tried to create (I've been trying to make games since GPT-3) that people log into, and genuinely have a good time.

Thanks for reading! See you on the tables!
